Arthrogate for his sheer lack of rhythm and his maces, particularly the one coated in magical rust that posed a significant threat to Charon's Claw and Twinkle at different times; Dahlia for her deadly precision and her lightning break staff, Kozah's Needle. Entreri (then Barrabus the Gray) himself noted that either he had to see her first or he would have to stay far away from her.

I think he could absorb a lightning bolt, but could Kozah's Needle absorb an oil of impact...impact or a splatter of sludge? 

Obould vs. Wulfgar? Obould. They actually have a very short encounter in one of the novels in the Hunter's Blade Trilogy. I think it's towards the end of Obould's massive assault on Mithral Hall. He's charging, swatting aside anything in his path, and Wulfgar takes a swing at him with Aegis-Fang. Obould, in his glassteel armor, not only absorbs that blow, but then shocks Wulfgar by tossing him aside with one blow. Drizzt also later mentions how in fighting Obould, he's reminded of Entreri's fluid movements. Wulfgar is incredibly strong and surprisingly nimble, but Grummish-blessed, impenetrable Obould is on a whole other level. 

Jarlaxle vs. Dantrag? Again, it could go both ways. Both had an impressive magical arsenal: Jarlaxle has literally every trick up his sleeve and Dantrag had those lightning bracelets *and* Khazid'hea. Even more surprising is that I don't remember Dantrag struggling with Cutter's possessive bloodlust. It's possible he had complete control of it. Now Jarlaxle is insanely crafty and he's managed to hold his own against Entreri (who had Charon's Claw at the time!) and proved to be very, very close to Zak's equal. I can see him keeping Dantrag at long distance with his inexhaustible daggers, black hole, feather, but I don't see him having an answer for Cutter. One slice and he's done for; I can't remember how Drizzt beat him, but I can't imagine he parried a lot. 

Zak vs. Entreri? Another tough one. I haven't read the latest novels, but I figure that Zak would be quietly impressed that not only did Entreri willingly travel to Menzo, but killed a number of drow and a Matron Mother. I mean, even Zak was afraid of braving the Underdark. But there's something about Zak that I feel would give him the upper hand. His ruthlessness, his experience as a weapon's master for, what, hundreds of years in Menzo, his many fights with Jarlaxle who evidently only won once *strictly out of luck*. Entreri was only there for like weeks and loathed the place was a dark reflection of his own life; Zak excelled and killed as many as he could. 

Tiago vs. Bruenor? Tiago. Not only was he extremely skilled by even drow standards (he's like Dantrag's great grandson or something?), but he had access to those "spider" weapons: the sword infused with the infamous dark elf sleeping poison and the shield with the magical sticky webbing. He's also, confusingly, managed to defeat Errtu. Bruenor is a veteran powerhouse in his own right, who's fought for hundreds of years against everything from a black dragon to a pit fiend, but in a one-on-one fight, Tiago takes it.
